Jessica Tran: FYI — Support is escalating NovaLedger onboarding. SSO fails intermittently during provisioning, customer is mid-trial and renewal is at risk. Need CS ownership and quick comms plan.
Ian Cole: Noted. Root cause looks like an edge case with their IdP metadata refresh. I can repro locally, logs show 503 from our auth proxy.
Mateo Ruiz: Can you drop the exact error? I want to confirm if it's a runtime config or infra routing.
Ian Cole: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-10T14:02:12Z ERROR auth-proxy request failed status=503 path=/saml/assert
x-request-id=4f7b2a
```
Ian Cole: Tried rolling auth-proxy, problem temporarily goes away then returns for 5–10m.
Priya Shah: This is the one with large enterprise SCIM + custom certs, correct? Renewal touchpoint scheduled for next Tues.
Jessica Tran: Yes. Renewal outreach is Tue; if this is still flaky they'll pause onboarding. Customer sent a support ticket saying they "can't finish SSO setup." Escalating to Priority-1 for CS/Support coordination.
Mateo Ruiz: Ops, can you throttle new SSO jobs to NovaLedger until we have a fix so we don't amplify? We should also surface a fallback UX (manual invite) to them.
Ian Cole: Agreed. I'll open a short-lived feature-flag to route their requests to a stable path. Patch ETA ~2h.
Priya Shah: I'll prepare a customer-friendly update. Draft below — please edit:
```
Hi Anna,
We're actively investigating an intermittent issue with SSO setup affecting some customers. Our engineers are implementing a temporary routing change to stabilize your setup. Expected resolution within 2–3 hours. In the meantime you can complete onboarding via manual invites (we can do this for you).
Will update again in 90 minutes.
— Priya (Redwood CS)
```
Jessica Tran: Good. Add: "We're prioritizing your org and will keep a dedicated channel open." Also cc sales for renewal context.
Ian Cole: Patch deployed to their org routing. Monitoring. If errors drop to <1% in 30m we consider stable.
deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-10_14:28 by ian.c completed: auth-proxy patch (canary to novaledger)
Mateo Ruiz: Seeing error rate drop. +1 on manual-invite offer.
Priya Shah: I'll send the update to Anna and include sales (matt@sales). I'll also create a short status doc and link it here.
Jessica Tran: Thanks team. Action items: Ian continue monitoring + escalate to eng-runtime if flaps reappear; Mateo coordinate manual invites; Priya send comms + loop sales; I'll own renewal risk flag and follow-up next day.
Ian Cole: Will do. If flaps reappear I'll open an eng-runtime ticket and tag @oncall.
Jessica Tran: Closing thread for now — updating the account health dashboard and note for renewal playbook. :thumbsup:
